visual_identity.core_identity: A severed troll arm still animated by supernatural regeneration, crawling like a grotesque hand-creature without graphic gore.
visual_identity.silhouette: Long muscular forearm ending in an oversized clawed hand, fingers acting like legs as the limb crawls.
visual_identity.head_features: No head; identity comes from troll skin, long proportions, and large clawed hand.
visual_identity.body_shape: Single elongated arm with large hand, bent wrist, and finger-walking posture.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly one severed troll arm and hand; fingers provide the crawling support. No torso, second arm, or legs.
visual_identity.surface: Tough troll skin with sparse bumps; severed end simplified and non-gory.

scene_identity.size_impression: A medium crawling limb, much larger than a human arm but clearly only one piece of a troll.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Palm/fingers and forearm visibly contact the floor or support surface while crawling.
behavior_style: crawling from a drain or doorway

known_failure_modes.correction: show exactly one severed arm with no torso, legs, or second arm
use simplified clean fantasy regeneration edge without blood detail
